tools.description: Return the canonical on-chain verification verdict for a TAG IT physical asset: its lifecycle state (MINTED, BOUND, ACTIVATED, CLAIMED, FLAGGED, RECYCLED), whether that state counts as authentic, and a re-derivable chain reference. Byte-identical to the public JSON at GET https://verify.tagit.networ
